pages.title: Cosmogenic Casing
pages.text: A casing built to contain the birth of a universe. Spin foam lattice, multiverse shard and cosmic neutronium are folded over a hyperlattice frame, around rift frame casing. It is unpleasantly heavy and quietly warm.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Universe Forge needed a shell strong enough for a Big Bang. Spin foam is the fabric of quantum spacetime, a multiverse shard is the boundary between universes, and cosmic neutronium held them both.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Quantum Gravity.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Inflation Chamber, Reality Lattice Casing, Universe Forge.
